fabric_findings_20260815.twin_question: Each CX-7 exposes 2 PFs: f0 = ASIC physical port 0 (DARK on this board, ethtool 'No cable'), f1 = physical port 1 (the cage). There is no second logical half of the cabled port to give NCCL.
fabric_findings_20260815.nccl_hca_verdict: NCCL_IB_HCA stays single-active-device per rail (roceP2p1s0f1 on rail B). Listing the dark f0 would point NCCL at a dead port. After the new switch fixes rail-A PFC, dual-RAIL (rocep1s0f1+roceP2p1s0f1 = 2x200G) is the real multi-HCA upgrade.
fabric_findings_20260815.gid_lesson: RoCEv2 GID indices differ per node (forge=5, anvil=7, ember=7, flame=3) and renumber when iface addresses change. Never hardcode -x 3 in perftest; always resolve dynamically like start-dspark-tp4.sh does.
